title: Schedule of Price Adjustment Terms, Online Orders
content:
The price adjustment terms of Online Orders are set per delivery service as follows; the figures are the same on all six services.

| Delivery service | Base price-adjustment window (calendar days after the placed date) | Adjustments per order line, at most | Smallest per-unit difference adjusted (USD) | Clearance price as reference | Flash-sale price as reference | Code-only price as reference |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Ground | 14 | 1 | 1.00 | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded |
| Pickup Point Delivery | 14 | 1 | 1.00 | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded |
| Standard Ground | 14 | 1 | 1.00 | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded |
| Expedited 2-Day | 14 | 1 | 1.00 | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded |
| Next Business Day | 14 | 1 | 1.00 | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded |
| Same-Day Courier | 14 | 1 | 1.00 | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded |

## Terms used in the schedule

- **Base price-adjustment window**: the window in calendar days after the placed date that applies to customers without a loyalty membership.
- **Adjustments per order line**: the most price adjustments one order line can receive.
- **Smallest per-unit difference**: the smallest difference per unit, in dollars and cents, that is adjusted.
- **Clearance price**, **flash-sale price** and **code-only price** (a price reachable only with a promotion code): "Excluded" means that kind of price is not accepted as a reference price.

## Per-unit difference against the 1.00 floor (hypothetical differences)

| Per-unit difference | Against the 1.00 floor |
|---|---|
| 0.99 | Below; not adjusted |
| 1.00 | At the floor; meets it |
| 4.50 | Above; meets it |
